Subject: SOC 2 Type II evidence delivery — transfer method and bridge letter

Hi Rafael,

We are kicking off the SOC 2 Type II evidence collection for the 2028 period for FinOptima. To keep the transfer aligned with our security requirements, we prefer one of the following options:

1) An encrypted S3 bundle (AES-256) — we will provide a public SSH key for asymmetric encryption and verify MD5/SHA256 checksums after download. Pre-signed, single-use links are acceptable if they expire within 48 hours.

2) A temporary SFTP drop (key-based auth) accessible from our auditor IPs (we will provide the list) with SCP available so we can pick up artifacts.

We also need a short bridge letter stating the audit period, confirmed scope (Prod only), and a note explaining any minor control changes since the last report. Ideally a PDF we can attach to our working papers.

Can you confirm which approach works and an estimated window for transfer? Also, do you have an internal manifest (CSV) of the files you plan to drop?

Thanks,
Marta
Senior Auditor, Eagle Audit

Hi all,

We can support both options; recommended default is an encrypted S3 bundle plus a one-time pre-signed URL that expires after the download. Details and operational notes below:

- Format: tar.gz containing per-control folders, with an evidence_manifest.csv at the root listing file name, control ID, created_at, and redaction flag.
- Encryption: we will encrypt the tar.gz with the auditor's RSA public key (client-side) and publish a pre-signed S3 GET link (single-use). Please provide your public key.
- Checksums: we will publish SHA256 and MD5 hashes alongside the S3 object in a small .sha256 file.
- IP allowlist: if you prefer SFTP instead, provide auditor IPv4s and we will open a timebox 36-hour window with jumpbox auditing.
- Redaction: we can provide both a redacted and unredacted bundle; unredacted will require a signed NDA from FinOptima.

Attachments: evidence_manifest.csv (sample), upload_instructions.txt — the manifest sample shows expected columns.

If that works, propose this schedule:
- Wed 12 Jun 09:00-11:00 PT: create bundle and submit DocuSign for FinOptima NDA (if unredacted needed).
- Wed 12 Jun 14:00 PT: publish pre-signed encrypted object and deliver link + .sha256.
- Window: link valid until Thu 13 Jun 14:00 PT (24-hour download window).

Please confirm public key and whether you need redacted or unredacted artifacts. If you confirm SFTP instead we'll provide a jumpbox host and ask for auditor key plus IPs.

— Kim
Evidence Ops Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: evidence_manifest.csv (csv), upload_instructions.txt (txt)
